request.description:
Use this route to authorize previously created transfers

This route is behind a firewall, so please use the Merchant Cabinet to specify the IP addresses of your authorizer service before using it.

To identify the transfer, you can use our UUID as `id` or you can specify your Order ID as `order_id`

You can provide additional data about transfer, such as `amount`, `currency`, `client_amount`, `client_currency` and `recipient`. If some of this data is provided, we will compare it with our data before completing the authorization.

item.description:
Callback (webhook) requests are sends from SYSTEM side to Merchant side.
1. Verification request [optional] – verify transfer callback happens on the step 3 the next after create
transfer and authorize it and before send transfer to bank processing [step 3 in a Block-Scheme –
optional request]. 'Verify' callback request can be sent for checking transfer before processing to 'Verify'
server in Merchant's server-side architecture for increase security level in case if 'Maker' server and
'Authorize' server has been compromised or hacked.
2. Notification request – it is a request of any event-related to transfer that the merchant has set for
notification. Notifications callbacks can be established for any type of event: create, success, reject, and
etc events. Each notification callback event can be set its own security keys.
